scenes.caption: 让想法开始运动
scenes.voiceover: 好的剪辑，让想法开始运动。

shot.rationale: 用纸张从静止到有序流动的动作建立开场，而非罗列文字。
shot.prompt: Vertical cinematic macro shot of ivory paper strips on a dark teal tabletop gradually lifting and flowing into an elegant spiral. Warm amber side lighting, tactile paper texture, slow controlled camera push in, refined editorial film, no people, no letters, no text, no logos. One continuous shot.

scenes.caption: 先讲好，再剪好
scenes.voiceover: 先讲清楚内容，再选择合适的镜头。

shot.rationale: 用安静的浅色标题镜头收束，与动态开场形成节奏对照。
